from datetime import date


def reconcile(bank, ledger, window=2):
    bank_parsed = [
        (index, item[0], date.fromisoformat(item[1]), item[2])
        for index, item in enumerate(bank)
    ]
    ledger_parsed = [
        (index, item[0], date.fromisoformat(item[1]), item[2])
        for index, item in enumerate(ledger)
    ]

    used_ledger = set()
    matches = []
    matched_bank = set()

    bank_order = sorted(bank_parsed, key=lambda item: (item[2], item[1]))

    for bank_index, bank_id, bank_date, bank_amount in bank_order:
        candidates = [
            item for item in ledger_parsed
            if item[0] not in used_ledger
            and item[3] == bank_amount
            and abs((item[2] - bank_date).days) <= window
        ]

        if candidates:
            ledger_index, ledger_id, _, _ = min(
                candidates, key=lambda item: (item[2], item[1])
            )
            used_ledger.add(ledger_index)
            matched_bank.add(bank_index)
            matches.append((bank_id, ledger_id))

    unmatched_bank = [
        item[0] for index, item in enumerate(bank)
        if index not in matched_bank
    ]
    unmatched_ledger = [
        item[0] for index, item in enumerate(ledger)
        if index not in used_ledger
    ]

    return matches, unmatched_bank, unmatched_ledger
